title: [LOGGED OUT] Mobile "Add It to Home Screen" banner can be closed
reason: Banner shown at bottom with X; X closes it. Mobile via Chrome mobileEmulation fallback (390x844, DPR 3, iPhone UA), not emulate_device.

steps.text: Open https://site.ludus-game.com/ in the browser on a phone screen (iPhone 14 size, 390x844) and wait until the page has finished loading.
steps.saw: Home page loaded at 390px wide; cookie banner and "Add It to Home Screen" banner visible.

steps.text: If a "How we use cookies" banner is shown, click "Dismiss".
steps.saw: Cookie banner shown; clicked Dismiss, banner closed.

steps.text: Is a banner with the text "Add It to Home Screen" shown at the bottom?
steps.saw: Banner at y=780..844 (bottom of the 844px viewport) with text "Add It to Home Screen" / "To got a quicker access !" and a green Claim button.

steps.text: Does the banner have an X (close) button?
steps.saw: White X button at the right edge of the banner (aria-label "Close pwa banner", 18x18 at x=356,y=802).

steps.text: Click the X (close) button of the banner. Do not click "Claim".
steps.saw: Clicked the X ("Close pwa banner"). Claim not clicked.

steps.text: Is the "Add It to Home Screen" banner gone?
steps.saw: Banner no longer on screen; no element with text "Add It to Home Screen" and no "Close pwa banner" button in the DOM.
